title: Personal Sender Account Tenure Days on a Cash Pickup Shortfall Re-issue
content:
**Sender accounts note.** A re-issue of a shortfall on a Cash Pickup transfer receives tenure days. They follow the sender's Personal Sender Account whose status is active, and they turn on two things together: the account's level, and how long the account has been open.

**Months open** are the whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the day of the re-issue.

| Personal Sender Account (active) | Days added to the re-issue window |
|---|---|
| Open at least 36 months, and level Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client | 7 |
| Open at least 12 months, and level Paloma Verified or Paloma Verified Plus | 3 |
| Any other account | none |

Both parts of a row must hold. The days are whole calendar days added to the re-issue window, so they move its last day of collection later.

## Combinations (hypothetical accounts)

| Level | Whole months open | Days |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Premier | 36 | 7 |
| Paloma Premier | 35 | none (under 36 months, and the 12-month row is for Paloma Verified or Paloma Verified Plus only) |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 40 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified | 12 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified | 11 | none |
| Paloma Starter | 60 | none |

Months open, hypothetical: an account opened on 10 May 2023 has been open 36 whole months on 20 May 2026.
